name: Toasted Sesame Oil
siboNotes: Pure oils are FODMAP-free and well-tolerated in SIBO. Use sparingly as it's calorie-dense and rich flavor means a little goes a long way.
preparationTips: Add at the end of cooking to preserve nutty flavor
Mix with rice vinegar for simple salad dressing
Store in cool, dark place to prevent rancidity
Use sparingly - intense flavor means 1-2 teaspoons often suffices
nutritionalHighlights: Source of lignans with antioxidant properties
